newsitem.title: UK: Brit Biotech sees U.S. filing Q1 1998.
newsitem.headline: Brit Biotech sees U.S. filing Q1 1998.

text.p: British Biotech Plc said on Wednesday that it expected to be able to apply for U.S. marketing approval for its acute pancreatitis drug Lexipafant in the first quarter of 1998.
Finance director James Noble told Reuters after the release of "positive" late-stage, or Phase III, data from European trials that studies in the U.S. were about one year behind those in Europe.
Noble said U.S. trials should be completed in mid-1997.
"By November 1997 we'll know if the U.S. trial was successful," opening the way to seeking marketing approval for the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the "the first quarter of 1998."
